name: Xi'an Bright Laser Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Bright Laser Technologies Co.,Ltd. delivers comprehensive solutions for metal additive manufacturing and restoration. Its extensive range of offerings includes bespoke products, specialized equipment, fundamental raw materials, proprietary software, along with advanced 3D printing and various other technical services. The company's services benefit a wide spectrum of industries, notably aerospace, national security, energy production, medicine, tooling, and the automotive sector. Established in 2011, its principal operations are located in Xi'an, People's Republic of China.
